name: Cusco City Tour
description: Explore the main archaeological and religious attractions of Cusco and its surroundings in a half-day tour, visiting the Temple of the Sun (Qorikancha) and the impressive Inca ruins of Sacsayhuamán, Qenqo, Pucapucara, and Tambomachay.

itinerary.title: Cusco City Tour
activities: Meeting at the Plaza de Armas in Cusco (9:00 am or 1:00 pm)
Exploration of Qenqo, Pucapucara, and Tambomachay
Stop at Cristo Blanco and Eucalyptus Forest
Return to Cusco (2:00 pm or 6:30 pm)

not_included: Entrance to Qorikancha (S/ 20 adult, S/ 10 student or child)

price_options.description: Includes professional guide and group transport
Personalized service with private guide and exclusive transportation

additional_info: The tour has two schedules: 9:00 am – 2:00 pm or 1:00 pm – 6:30 pm
It is recommended to buy the Tourist Ticket in advance
Unincluded entrance fees are paid in cash on the day of the tour

faq.question: Are entrance fees to the sites included?
faq.answer: No, they must be paid separately (Qorikancha and Tourist Ticket).

faq.question: Where does the tour start?
faq.answer: The starting point is the Plaza de Armas in Cusco.

faq.question: Can I take the tour any day?
faq.answer: Yes, it is available all year.

name: Sacred Valley VIP
description: A full-day tour of the most important sites in the Sacred Valley of the Incas, including the Inca engineering of Moray, the famous Maras Salt Mines, the archaeological complex of Ollantaytambo, and the artisan market of Pisaq. Buffet lunch is included.

itinerary.title: Sacred Valley VIP
activities: Transfer to Chinchero and guided visit
Tour of Moray and explanation of the Inca agricultural laboratory
Visit to the Maras Salt Mines
Buffet lunch at a tourist restaurant
Tour of Ollantaytambo and its archaeological zone
Final visit to Pisaq and its market/handicrafts

not_included: Tourist Ticket (for Chinchero, Moray, Pisaq, and Ollantaytambo)
Entrance to Salt Mines (S/. 15 Peruvians, S/. 20 foreigners)

price_options.description: Includes group transport, professional guide, and buffet lunch
Personalized service with exclusive transport and private guide

optional_services.service: Hotel pickup outside the historic center
Guide in an additional language (English, French, Italian)

additional_info: It is mandatory to have the Tourist Ticket (partial or general)
The entrance to the Salt Mines is not included and is paid in cash at the site
The buffet lunch is included in the tour

faq.question: Is lunch included?
faq.answer: Yes, it includes a buffet lunch.

faq.question: Which tickets do I need to buy?
faq.answer: The Tourist Ticket (for the archaeological sites) and the entrance to the Salt Mines.

faq.question: Is this tour available every day?
faq.answer: Yes, the Sacred Valley VIP is available all year.

name: Machu Picchu + Sacred Valley 2D/1N
description: A package that combines a full tour of the Sacred Valley of the Incas (Chinchero, Moray, Salt Mines, Ollantaytambo) on the first day, with a guided visit to the Inca Citadel of Machu Picchu on the second day, including train and accommodation.

itinerary.title: Sacred Valley VIP + Train to Aguas Calientes
activities: Visit to Chinchero and its artisan center
Entrance to the Maras Salt Mines
Buffet lunch at a tourist restaurant
Evening train from Ollantaytambo to Aguas Calientes
Overnight stay in accommodation in Aguas Calientes

itinerary.title: Machu Picchu + Return to Cusco
activities: Breakfast at the hotel in Aguas Calientes
Bus ride up to Machu Picchu
Free time to explore and take photos
Return by bus to Aguas Calientes
Time for lunch and strolling in the town
Transfer by tourist transport to Cusco (arrival approx. 10:00 pm)

includes: Bus tickets up and down to Machu Picchu
Lunches (1 – buffet in the Sacred Valley)
not_included: Dinner on Day 1 in Aguas Calientes
Entrance fees to the Sacred Valley (Tourist Ticket)
Entrance to Salt Mines (S/ 15 national – S/ 20 foreign)

other_items: Cash for entrance fees and extras

price_options.description: Transport, guide, Expedition train, Machu Picchu entrance, bus, 1 night hotel, 1 breakfast, and 1 buffet lunch
Includes the above with better train category and superior hotel
Exclusive transport, private guide, and choice of accommodation

optional_services.service: Accommodation in 3★ or 4★ hotel in Aguas Calientes
Entrance to Huayna Picchu or Machu Picchu Mountain (subject to availability)

additional_info: The train departs from Ollantaytambo in the afternoon of Day 1 and returns on Day 2 in the evening.
Entrance to Machu Picchu is approximately between 07:00 am – 12:00 pm.
The tour does not include dinner in Aguas Calientes, but there are multiple restaurants available.
It is recommended to buy tickets in advance, especially in high season.

faq.question: Does the tour include lunch in Machu Picchu?
faq.answer: No, the included lunch is on Day 1 (buffet in the Sacred Valley).

faq.question: Where do we spend the night?
faq.answer: In accommodation in Aguas Calientes (included).

faq.question: Does this tour include entrance fees to all archaeological sites in the Sacred Valley?
faq.answer: No, the Tourist Ticket and the entrance to the Salt Mines must be purchased separately.

name: Mountain Adventure (Humantay + Rainbow Mountain + 7 Ausangate Lakes)
description: A challenging 3-day itinerary that combines the three most popular mountain hikes in Cusco: Humantay Lake, Rainbow Mountain (Vinicunca), and the 7 Ausangate Lakes, with breakfasts and lunches included.

itinerary.title: Humantay Lake
activities: Hike of approx. 1h30 min to Humantay Lake
Free time for photos and rest

itinerary.title: Rainbow Mountain (Vinicunca)
activities: Hike of 1h30 min to Rainbow Mountain summit
Free time to enjoy the view and take photos

itinerary.title: 7 Ausangate Lakes
activities: Hike of approx. 3 to 4 hours to visit the 7 Ausangate Lakes

not_included: Entrance to Humantay Lake (S/. 10 nationals / S/. 20 foreigners)
Entrance to Rainbow Mountain (S/. 15 nationals / S/. 25 foreigners)
Horses (optional, from S/. 50 – 80 depending on route)

clothing: Warm jacket (low temperatures in the morning)
other_items: Cash for entrance fees and horses

price_options.description: Includes transport, professional guide, 3 breakfasts, 3 lunches, trekking poles, oxygen, and first aid.
Private service with exclusive transport, personalized guide, and flexible schedules.

optional_services.service: Support horses at Humantay or Vinicunca
Extra accommodation in Cusco (before or after the tour)

additional_info: This tour combines 3 of the most famous hikes in Cusco.
It is recommended to acclimatize for at least 2 days in Cusco before taking these excursions.
The hikes are moderate to challenging intensity and require good physical condition.
It is important to bring warm clothing and appropriate mountain gear.

faq.question: Do I need prior trekking experience?
faq.answer: No, but being in good physical condition is recommended.

faq.question: Are horses available?
faq.answer: Yes, horses can be rented at Humantay and Rainbow Mountain (approx. S/. 80).

faq.question: What if I don't want to go to the Pacchanta Hot Springs?
faq.answer: It is optional; the guide organizes free time for those who wish to rest or bathe.

name: Full Adrenaline (Rafting + Quad Bikes + Horseback Riding)
description: A 2-day adventure package combining Rafting on the Urubamba River, a Quad Bike tour to Moray and Maras Salt Mines, and Horseback Riding to archaeological sites near Cusco, ideal for adrenaline junkies.

itinerary.title: Rafting on the Urubamba River
activities: Safety talk and equipment distribution (helmet, life vest, neoprene suit, paddle)
Return to hotel in Cusco (05:00 pm)

itinerary.title: Quad Bikes + Horseback Riding
activities: Quad biking with visits to Moray, Maras Salt Mines, and Huaypo Lagoon
Horseback Riding in the afternoon: Zone X, Temple of the Moon, and Inca's Face
Return to hotel in Cusco (06:00 pm)

includes: Rafting equipment (life vest, helmet, neoprene suit, paddle)
One horse per passenger with saddle and riding helmet
Sauna and zipline at rafting camp
not_included: Entrance fees to Moray and Salt Mines

clothing: Light clothing and swimwear for rafting
Comfortable clothing for quad biking and horseback riding
other_items: Cash for entrance fees and extras

price_options.description: Includes transport, guide, rafting with lunch, quad bikes, horses, and complete equipment.
Includes exclusive transport, personalized guide, and flexibility in schedules.

optional_services.service: Hotel pickup outside the historic center
Guide in an additional language (English, French, Italian)

additional_info: Rafting is carried out with all safety measures.
The rafting difficulty level is suitable for beginners (class II – III).
Quad bikes are driven individually (one per person).
The horseback riding is guided by a muleteer and is suitable for beginners.

faq.question: Is it necessary to know how to swim for rafting?
faq.answer: No, the life jacket and safety equipment are included.

faq.question: Can I drive a quad bike if I've never done it before?
faq.answer: Yes, a talk and practice session is provided before the tour.

faq.question: Are the horses safe for beginners?
faq.answer: Yes, each passenger has an assigned horse and is accompanied by a guide and muleteer.

name: Rainbow Mountain (Vinicunca)
description: Full-day excursion to the famous Rainbow Mountain (Vinicunca), an altitude challenge (over 5,000 meters above sea level) with spectacular Andean landscapes. Includes breakfast and lunch en route.

itinerary.title: Rainbow Mountain
activities: Hike of approx. 1h30 min to the summit of the mountain
Free time for photos and rest at the summit

not_included: Entrance to Rainbow Mountain (S/. 15 nationals, S/. 25 foreigners)

price_options.description: Includes transport, guide, breakfast, lunch, trekking poles, oxygen, and first aid kit.
Exclusive transport, private guide, flexible schedules.

additional_info: The hike is moderate-to-high difficulty due to altitude (over 5,000 masl).
It is recommended to acclimatize in Cusco for at least 2 days prior.
Bring warm clothing and enough water.

faq.question: Is the hike very difficult?
faq.answer: It is not technical, but the altitude can affect; horses are available.

faq.question: Is the entrance fee included?
faq.answer: No, it is paid at the site (S/. 15 – 25 depending on nationality).

faq.question: Can children go?
faq.answer: Yes, but it is recommended for children from 8 years old with good physical condition.

name: Q'eswachaka Inca Bridge
description: Full-day trip to visit the Q’eswachaka Inca Bridge, the last Inca suspension bridge made of vegetable fiber that is renewed annually. A cultural and ancestral engineering experience, declared Intangible Cultural Heritage of Humanity by UNESCO.

itinerary.title: Q’eswachaka
activities: Visit to the Q’eswachaka Inca Bridge and cultural explanation
Free time to take photos and cross the bridge

price_options.description: Includes transport, professional guide, breakfast, and lunch.

optional_services.service: Extension to nearby visits (lakes in the area)

additional_info: The Q’eswachaka Bridge is Intangible Cultural Heritage of Humanity (UNESCO).
It is rebuilt every year by local communities using ancestral techniques.
The walk to the bridge is short and easy.

faq.question: Is it safe to cross the bridge?
faq.answer: Yes, it is made of ichu (Andean straw) and renewed annually.

faq.question: Is the entrance fee included?
faq.answer: No, it is paid in the community itself (S/. 20).

faq.question: Can it be visited at any time of the year?
faq.answer: Yes, but the best time is in June when it is rebuilt.

name: Humantay Lake
description: Full-day excursion to visit the beautiful Humantay Lake, with turquoise waters and surrounded by snow-capped mountains. A moderate-difficulty hike ideal for enjoying the natural beauty of the Peruvian Andes. Includes breakfast and lunch.

itinerary.title: Humantay Lake
activities: Hike of 1h30 min to the lake
Free time for photos and rest at the lake

not_included: Entrance to Humantay Lake (S/. 10 nationals, S/. 20 foreigners)

price_options.description: Transport, guide, breakfast, lunch, trekking poles, first aid.
Personalized service, exclusive transport, private guide.

additional_info: The hike is of moderate difficulty, ideal for acclimatized people.
It is recommended to arrive in Cusco at least 2 days prior.
The lake is over 4,200 meters above sea level.

faq.question: Is the hike difficult?
faq.answer: It is moderate, but a horse can be rented.

faq.question: Are entrance fees included?
faq.answer: No, they are paid in cash at the entrance.

faq.question: Can it be done with family?
faq.answer: Yes, as long as they are in good physical condition.

name: Waqrapukara 1 Day
description: Trekking excursion to the impressive archaeological site of Waqrapukara, a pre-Inca fortress high up on a canyon, with spectacular views. The tour includes breakfast and lunch en route.

itinerary.title: Waqrapukara
activities: Hike of approx. 2 hours to Waqrapukara
Guided visit to the archaeological site

price_options.description: Transport, guide, breakfast, lunch, and first aid.
Exclusive service, private transport, personal guide.

optional_services.service: Extension with visit to local communities
